comment: Curated games that need the real Windows (kernel anti-cheat). Fields: id, name (English), name_ko, icon (theme icon name), launch {type: riot|uri|exe, ...} = what the Windows helper starts, exit_processes = process names (without .exe) that mean 'the game is still running', aliases = ids the Windows helper reports for the same game (riot-<product>, steam-<appid>, epic-<appname>), exe_names = lower-case file name patterns the Windows Engine hands over to delay-winboot, featured = show in the Start menu before the Windows helper reported what is installed, reason = Korean explanation. Site additions: /etc/delayos/winboot/games.d/*.json (same format).
comment_install: Installing from DelayOS (delay-winboot --install ID / --install-launcher ID, docs/windows-switch.md). launchers[]: id (steam|epic|riot|battlenet|ea|ubisoft), name, summary (Korean), account (Korean, whose login the user needs), url = OFFICIAL vendor installer (https, never a mirror; the Windows helper also checks the host against its own list and the Authenticode signer), page = official download page (opened in the browser when there is no url or the download fails), file = name to save as (.exe/.msi), publisher = expected signer (informational, the helper has its own list), args + silent = only switches the vendor supports, elevate = start the installer elevated (no UAC prompt). games[].install: launcher, optional url/page/file (Riot: the game's own installer, bundled = it installs the launcher AND the game), trigger = what starts the in-launcher install (same format as launch), detect = how the helper sees that the game is there ({type: steam, appid} | {type: epic, app} | {type: riot, product, min_gb}), size_gb, account, anticheat, anticheat_note (Korean), requires (tpm2, secureboot: needed on Windows 11). URLs last checked 2026-11-26.

games.name: VALORANT
games.reason: 발로란트는 Riot Vanguard(커널 안티치트)를 사용하며, Vanguard는 Linux에서 동작하지 않습니다.

install.anticheat_note: Windows 11에서는 TPM 2.0과 Secure Boot가 켜져 있어야 실행됩니다. Vanguard를 설치한 뒤 Windows를 한 번 다시 시작해야 게임이 시작됩니다.
